howItWorks.introTitleHighlight: Taageerada Daryeelka Dhalmada ee Bilaashka Ah
howItWorks.introDesc: Go Nurture Initiative CIC waxay bixisaa waxbarasho daryeelka dhalmada oo bilaash ah oo dhaqan ahaan loo habeeyey iyada oo loo marayo nidaam tixraac oo sugan. Waa kan sida nidaamku u shaqeeyo — laga bilaabo tixraaca koowaad ilaa taageerada bulshada ee joogtada ah.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Xirfadle daryeel caafimaad, umuliso, booqde caafimaad, ama hay'ad bulsho ayaa gartaa haweeney qaali ah oo ka faa'iidaysan karta barnaamijkeena. Waxay soo gudbiyaan tixraac sugan iyada oo loo marayo portal-ka lammaanaha oo ay ogolaanshaheeda la socoto.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Kooxdayadu waxay dib u eegaan tixraaca waxayna geliyaan haweeneyda mid ka mid ah saddexda kooxood ee sanadlaha ah. Koox kastaa waxay taageertaa ilaa 10 haween ah, iyada oo la hubinayo daryeel shaqsiyeed oo dhaqan ahaan loo habeeyey inta lagu jiro safarka.
howItWorks.step3Title: Barnaamijka Daryeelka Dhalmada ee Bilaashka Ah
howItWorks.step3Desc: Haweenku waxay helaan waxbarasho dhamaystiran oo daryeelka dhalmada, diyaarinta ummulsiga, iyo taageerada dhalmada ka dib — dhammaan waxaa lagu bixiyaa jawi sugan, soo dhaweyn leh, iyo luqado badan oo leh turjumaad xirfadeed oo Carabi, Soomaali, Yukreeniyaan, Faarisi, Tigrinya, Kurdish, iyo Ingiriisi.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Dhalmada ka dib, hooyooyinku waxay sii wataan inay helaan kalfadhiyo taageero dhalmada ka dib, fursado isku xirka asxaabta, iyo gelitaanka joogtada ah ee shabakadeena bulshada — iyada oo la hubinayo in aan haweeney lagaga tagin kaligeed bilaha ugu horreeya ee muhiimka ah ee hooyonimada.
howItWorks.bridgeTitle: Sida Iibka Ganacsigu U Maalgeliyo Daryeelka Bilaashka Ah
howItWorks.bridgeDesc: Iib kasta oo ka yimaada shirkadda hooyada ee ganacsiga, Nurtured and Nourished Women's Health Ltd, wuxuu si toos ah u taageeraa barnaamijyada bulshada ee bilaashka ah ee ay bixiso Go Nurture Initiative CIC iyada oo loo marayo qaabka Mas'uuliyadda Shirkadda ee Bulshada.
howItWorks.bridgeStep1Desc: Iibso xirmooyinka waxbarashada hooyonimada ee Nurtured and Nourished
howItWorks.bridgeStep2Desc: Qayb ka mid ah faa'iidada ayaa loo wareejiyaa Go Nurture CIC
howItWorks.bridgeStep3Desc: Lacagtu waxay bixisaa taageero daryeelka dhalmada oo bilaash ah haweenka qaaliga ah ee Norfolk
howItWorks.ctaTitle: Diyaar Ma U Tahay Inaad Samayso Tixraac?
howItWorks.ctaDesc: Haddii aad tahay xirfadle daryeel caafimaad, hay'ad bulsho, ama koox diimeed, waxaan kugu soo dhaweynaynaa inaad ku biirto shabakadeena lammaanaha tixraaca.
